title: ⛽ Trump Promised $2 Gas. Uh-Oh. | Chris Cillizza
description:
Is the 2026 midterm election really this simple? ⛽️

With the national average gas price above $4 a gallon—and every day in August clearing that mark for the first time on record—voters are seeing a stark economic message every time they drive past a gas station.

In this video, I break down why rising gas prices could become a major political problem for Donald Trump and Republicans heading into November. We look at:

📈 Why gas prices are at historic August highs

🌍 How the escalating conflict with Iran and disruption in the Strait of Hormuz could keep oil prices elevated

🚢 Why dramatically fewer ships moving through the Strait matters for the global oil supply

🗳️ The polling showing that high gas prices may change how Americans vote—including many non-MAGA Republicans

💰 Why Trump’s push on oil refiners signals real concern inside the White House

Politicians and pundits love to overcomplicate elections. But sometimes voters make their decisions based on the most visible, immediate reality in their lives: the price on the sign at the gas station.
